title: Cell dry mass over the cell cycle (per generation)
interpretation: Per-cell growth-and-division across the baseline ensemble (variant 0). Each line is one cell's monotonic growth ramp, coloured by generation: gen-1 cells (blue) grow ~390->700 fg and divide near a doubling of mass; gen-2 cells (orange) grow from ~360 fg. Where a partition packs more than one cell (an extra unrecorded division), each cell is drawn as its own line (split on the dry_mass_fold_change reset) rather than joined into a spurious vertical sawtooth. Confirms exponential single-cell growth with division near a doubling of mass.
command: v2ecoli native analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/cell_mass.py) over .pbg/runs/showcase2-baseline-full/sweep/showcase2_baseline parquet; rendered to PNG via vl_convert
